mapper.select: /* TITLENAME:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) PRODNAME：产品名称（普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取母产品名称） PRODID：产品代码（普通产品取产品代码 ,分级产品取子产品代码） REGCODE：产品登记编码（普通产品取产品登记编码 ,分级产品取母产品登记编码） */ SELECT RPI.PROD_ID innerProdId, CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||'（'||RPI.PROD_ID||'）' ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END titleName, /*CASE WHEN RPI.IS_GRADE = '01' THEN RPI2.PROD_NAME ||RPI.PROD_NAME ELSE RPI.PROD_NAME END prodName,*/ NVL(RPI2.PROD_NAME,RPI.PROD_NAME) prodName, RPI.PROD_RE regCode FROM REP_PROD_INFO RPI LEFT JOIN REP_PROD_INFO RPI2 ON RPI.P_PROD_ID = RPI2.PROD_ID AND RPI2.STATUS = 'E' WHERE RPI.PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND RPI.STATUS = 'E'

SELECT TO_CHAR(PRI.VALUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') valueDate, TO_CHAR(ROUND(NVL(PRI.W_YIELD,0),4),'FM9999999999999990.0000') wYield, TO_CHAR(ROUND(NVL(PRI.YIELD_7,0) * 100,4),'FM9999999999999990.0000')||'%' yield7 , '1.0000' unitValue, '1.0000' unitValueT, '1.0000' subValue, '1.0000' redValue FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO INNER JOIN REP_PROD_INDEX PRI ON PRI.PROD_ID = INFO.PROD_ID AND PRI.STATUS = 'E' WHERE INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND PRI.VALUE_DATE <= #{edate} AND PRI.VALUE_DATE >= #{vdate} ORDER BY PRI.VALUE_DATE DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(PRI.VALUE_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') valueDate, TO_CHAR(ROUND(NVL(PRI.UNIT_VALUE,0),4),'FM9999999999999990.0000') unitValue, TO_CHAR(ROUND(NVL(PRI.UNIT_VALUE_T,0),4),'FM9999999999999990.0000') unitValueT, TO_CHAR(ROUND(NVL(PRI.UNIT_VALUE,0),4),'FM9999999999999990.0000') subValue, /*需要结合产品基本信息中“固定持有天数“字段进行判断： （1）固定持有天数为0（即日申季赎、日申月赎产品），需要根据产品排期表判断，当前最新净值日期是否是该产品某开放周期的“开放期结束日”， 如果是的话，则当前的净值信息赎回价格=申购价格；若最新净值日期不是某一周期的“开放期结束日”，则赎回价格字段置空； （2）固定持有天数不等于0（产品成立超过固定持有天数后，后续每一天都可以进行赎回），自”子产品成立日+固定持有天数-1“后的净值公告赎回价格=申购价格；在此之前生成的净值公告，赎回价格置空*/ CASE WHEN nvl(INFO.HOLDDAY,0) = 0 THEN CASE WHEN DPP.PROD_PLAN_ID IS NOT NULL THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(NVL(PRI.UNIT_VALUE,0),4),'FM9999999999999990.0000') ELSE NULL END ELSE CASE WHEN TO_DATE(#{valueDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= (INFO.SET_DATE + nvl(INFO.HOLDDAY,0) - 1) THEN TO_CHAR(ROUND(NVL(PRI.UNIT_VALUE,0),4),'FM9999999999999990.0000') ELSE NULL END END AS redValue FROM REP_PROD_INFO INFO INNER JOIN REP_PROD_INDEX PRI ON PRI.PROD_ID =INFO.PROD_ID AND PRI.STATUS = 'E' LEFT JOIN DIS_PROD_PLAN DPP ON DPP.PROD_ID = NVL(INFO.P_PROD_ID,INFO.PROD_ID) AND DPP.OPEN_END_DATE =PRI.VALUE_DATE WHERE INFO.PROD_ID = #{prodId} AND PRI.VALUE_DATE = TO_DATE(#{valueDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
select v.prod_id pProdId, r.PROD_ID prodId from V_REP_PROD_INFO v inner join REP_PROD_INFO r on r.P_PROD_ID=v.prod_id where v.PROD_ID = #{prodId} and v.rep_prod_type='02'
select v.P_PROD_ID pProdId from REP_PROD_INFO v where v.PROD_ID = #{prodId} and v.rep_prod_type='02'
